description: Browse the CryptoRefills catalog for a country: the fulfillable brands (gift cards + mobile top-ups), filtered by `query` (brand/family name) and/or `category`, in-stock first, plus the popular picks and the category keys. The first step of a purchase (brand discovery) — feed a brand into wallet_list_giftcard_products. Gated on the operator's giftcardEnabled toggle (GIFTCARDS_DISABLED when off). Read-only, moves no money.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. BR). Defaults to the shop config country.

name: wallet_list_giftcards

brands.description: Fulfillable brands (gift cards + mobile recharge), filtered, in-stock first.

is_out_of_stock.description: In-stock brands sort first; out-of-stock last (kept, not removed).

categories.description: Distinct category keys for further filtering.

popular_brands.description: The operator's popular picks for the country.

is_out_of_stock.description: In-stock brands sort first; out-of-stock last (kept, not removed).

title: List gift-card brands (catalog)
